e.title: 一家挪威保险公司把自己的**设计系统**开源成 MIT 项目（★77／fork 32）：**一份合并包 ＋ 可分开使用的样式表**，**两条发布通道（稳定与预发布）的过程逐步写出**，并**逐条说明为什么要关掉 ESLint 以免与所选工具冲突**
e.title_en: A Norwegian insurer has open-sourced its design system under MIT — 77 stars and 32 forks — with one consolidated package plus separately usable stylesheets, a two-channel release process written out step by step, and an explicit account of why ESLint should be disabled so it does not conflict with the chosen tooling
e.title_hk: 一家挪威保險公司把自己的**設計系統**開源成 MIT 項目（★77／fork 32）：**一份合併包 ＋ 可分開使用的樣式表**，**兩條發布通道（穩定與預發布）的過程逐步寫出**，並**逐條說明為什麼要關掉 ESLint 以免與所選工具衝突**
e.summary: 一家**挪威保险公司**（Fremtind）**把自己对外的设计系统开源**（MIT，线上为 jokul.fremtind.no）：**提供现成的 React 组件，以及用于其基础组件与设计模式（Design Patterns）的 CSS 与 SCSS 样式表**，**并说明组件与样式表现在作为**一份合并包**交付**（**`@fremtind/jokul`**），**而 CSS 仍作为单独样式表提供**——**逐字理由是「如果你不用 React，仍然可以使用 Jøkul」**；**其最值得记的一处是它把**两条发布通道的完整过程**写成了十步**——**`main` 发布稳定版；`release/next` 在每次向 `main` 推送时**自动同步**以保持预发布分支跟随已合并并已稳定发布的内容**；**若同步遇到冲突，则复用一条固定的同步分支与**一个同步 PR** 供人工解决；**当该同步 PR 不再需要时，只要同步分支里没有 `release/next` 缺失的自有提交，就自动清理****——**并给出 changeset 流程与 `pnpm release:pre:exit`／`release:version` 等具体命令**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 它逐条说明**为什么要把 ESLint 关掉****（**逐字「使你的 IDE 使用 Biome，以免它与我们的设置争吵」**，**并给出要取消勾选的具体项与说明「这些改动也应在 Workspace 下做」**）；**② 它有一个**挪威语的贡献者行为准则**并逐字称 Jøkul 是一个开放而积极的共同体**；**③ 实测根目录含 `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`、`.all-contributorsrc`、`.czrc`、`.changeset/`、`.husky/`、`.nvmrc` 与 `visual-regression/`**（**⭐ 即**贡献者名录、提交规范、变更集、Git 钩子、Node 版本与视觉回归各自有位置**）
e.summary_hk: 一家**挪威保險公司**（Fremtind）**把自己對外的設計系統開源**（MIT，線上為 jokul.fremtind.no）：**提供現成的 React 組件，以及用於其基礎組件與設計模式（Design Patterns）的 CSS 與 SCSS 樣式表**，**並說明組件與樣式表現在作為**一份合併包**交付**（**`@fremtind/jokul`**），**而 CSS 仍作為單獨樣式表提供**——**逐字理由是「如果你不用 React，仍然可以使用 Jøkul」**；**其最值得記的一處是它把**兩條發布通道的完整過程**寫成了十步**——**`main` 發布穩定版；`release/next` 在每次向 `main` 推送時**自動同步**以保持預發布分支跟隨已合併並已穩定發布的內容**；**若同步遇到衝突，則複用一條固定的同步分支與**一個同步 PR** 供人工解決；**當該同步 PR 不再需要時，只要同步分支裡沒有 `release/next` 缺失的自有提交，就自動清理****——**並給出 changeset 流程與 `pnpm release:pre:exit`／`release:version` 等具體命令**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 它逐條說明**為什麼要把 ESLint 關掉****（**逐字「使你的 IDE 使用 Biome，以免它與我們的設置爭吵」**，**並給出要取消勾選的具體項與說明「這些改動也應在 Workspace 下做」**）；**② 它有一個**挪威語的貢獻者行為準則**並逐字稱 Jøkul 是一個開放而積極的共同體**；**③ 實測根目錄含 `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`、`.all-contributorsrc`、`.czrc`、`.changeset/`、`.husky/`、`.nvmrc` 與 `visual-regression/`**（**⭐ 即**貢獻者名錄、提交規範、變更集、Git 鉤子、Node 版本與視覺回歸各自有位置**）
e.summary_en: A Norwegian insurer has open-sourced its design system under MIT, live at its own domain, offering ready-made React components plus CSS and SCSS stylesheets for its basic components and design patterns, with components and stylesheets now delivered as one consolidated package while the CSS remains available as separate stylesheets for the stated reason that you can still use it without React; **its most notable feature is a ten-step account of a two-channel release process** — the main branch publishes stable versions while a release-next branch is automatically synced on every push to main so the prerelease branch keeps pace with what has already been merged and stably published; **when a sync hits conflicts, a fixed sync branch and a single sync pull request are reused for manual resolution, and the sync branch is cleaned up automatically once it is no longer needed, provided it holds no own commits missing from the release branch** — with the changeset flow and specific release commands given; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **it explains item by item why ESLint should be disabled** so it does not quarrel with the chosen tooling, naming the exact checkbox to clear and noting that the same changes should be made in the workspace settings; **it carries a code of conduct written in Norwegian describing the project as an open and positive community where everyone should feel welcome**; **and its root measurably holds a code of conduct, an all-contributors configuration, a commitizen configuration, a changeset directory, git hooks, a pinned Node version file and a visual regression directory**
e.body:
**fremtind-design-system**（仓库 `fremtind/jokul`，站点名 Jøkul）**是一家挪威保险公司（Fremtind）开源的对**外**设计系统**：**其 README 首句逐字为** **「**Jøkul** er et designsystem utviklet av Fremtind.」**（**「Jøkul 是由 Fremtind 开发的设计系统」**）。**实测 ★77、fork 32、许可 **MIT**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 **626,003 KB**、**创建 2019-06-14**、最后推送 2026-09-10、topics 为 `design-system`／`designsystem`／`fremtind`／`react`／`sass`／`scss`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建远早于解冻窗口**，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 31,193 字节（**挪威语**）**；**仓库实测共 **1,776 个文件、551 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把平时不外传的东西拿出来」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**唯一由**一家保险公司自己的工程组织**发布、且已长期维护的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一家保险公司把自己的设计系统开源出去，而交付方式被逐条说明**——**逐字为**：**「Jøkul gir deg **ferdige React-komponenter** samt **CSS- og SCSS-stilark** for de grunnleggende komponentene og **designmønstrene** til Fremtind. De følger **Fremtinds designprinsipper**.」**；**并逐字说明打包方式的变更**：**「Alle komponenter og stilark leveres nå som **én konsolidert pakke**: `@fremtind/jokul`. **CSSen er tilgjengelig som separate stilark, så om du ikke bruker React kan du fremdeles bruke Jøkul.**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「设计系统」在这里指的是**对外的组件库与设计模式**（**而不是内部文档**）**——**⭐ 即**一家保险公司把自己**面向客户的界面语言**开源了**；**② ⭐⭐ **合并包与可分用样式表**并存，**且理由逐字写给不用 React 的人****（**⭐ 即**交付形态的选择附带了**面向谁**的说明**）；**③ **组件**遵循该公司的设计原则**（**⭐ 即**这不是通用组件库，**而是**带具体品牌约束的产物****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **两条发布通道的完整过程被写成十步，连冲突处理与自动清理都写明了**——**逐字含**：**「`main` publiserer **stabile versjoner**.」**；**「I tillegg **synkes `release/next` automatisk med `main` ved hver push til `main`**, slik at prerelease-branchen holder seg oppdatert med det som allerede er merged og publisert stabilt. **Hvis synken treffer mergekonflikter gjenbrukes en fast sync-branch og én sync-PR inn mot `release/next` for manuell konfliktløsning. Når sync-PR-en ikke lenger trengs, ryddes sync-branchen opp automatisk så lenge den ikke inneholder egne commits som mangler i `release/next`.**」**；**并逐条给出 changeset 流程与具体命令**（**`pnpm changeset`、`pnpm release:pre:exit`、`pnpm release:version`，**以及「把 `release/next` 合回 `main` 后，下一次从 `main` 的发布即为普通稳定版」**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **两条通道的**关系**被讲清**（**稳定通道 `main` 与预发布通道 `release/next`，**且后者**自动跟随前者****）**——**⭐ 即**「预发布分支不会落后于已稳定的东西」**是**被机制保证的**，**而不是靠人记得**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **冲突处理写明为**复用一条固定分支与一个 PR**（**而不是每次新建**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是一个**很具体且可复用的协作细节**；**③ ⭐⭐ **自动清理带一个**前置条件****（**「只要该分支不含 `release/next` 缺失的自有提交」**）**——**⭐ 即**防止把未合并的提交一起删掉**；**④ ⭐⭐ **命令级步骤逐条给出**，**使这套流程**可被他人照着做****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐条说明**为什么要把 ESLint 关掉****——**逐字为**：**「Vi bruker verktøyet **Biome** for både formatering og linting… **Linting og formatering skjer automatisk ved commit**, men vi anbefaler også at du setter opp IDEen din til å bruke Biome **så den ikke krangler med våre innstillinger**.」**；**并逐字给出具体操作**：**「Deretter kan du søke etter `eslint` og fjerne avkrysningen ved "Eslint: Enable", for å unngå at Eslint krangler med Biome. Sørg også for at "Eslint > Format: Enable" er skrudd av. **Disse endringene bør også gjøres under "Workspace".**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「以免它与**我们的设置争吵**」**——**⭐ 即**它承认**工具冲突是真实问题**，**并**把自己一侧的选择（Biome）讲明****；**② ⭐⭐ **它给出**可照做的具体项**（**取消勾选 "Eslint: Enable"、关掉 "Eslint > Format: Enable"**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「请自行配置」，**而是**给出确切的开关****（**⭐ 与第 341 轮 [[medical-opinion-extractor]] 的「自动禁用 OCR 并在画面说明」同族：**都拒绝**静默的工具冲突**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「这些改动也应在 Workspace 下做」**——**⭐ 即**它考虑到了**多项目工作区**这一情形**。**④ ⭐⭐ **贡献与治理面齐备，且行为准则为挪威语**——**逐字为**：**「**Jøkul er et åpent og positivt felleskap der alle skal føle seg velkommen.** Gjør deg kjent med **våre etiske regler for bidragsytere**（`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`）før du deltar med bidrag.」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **有独立的行为准则文件，**且它以挪威语撰写****；**② ⭐⭐ **其 README 的章节结构含 Code of Conduct、**Lisens** 与 **Bidragsytere（贡献者）**三节**（**⭐ 即**产权、行为与贡献者三者各有位置**）；**③ **本词条**实测**根目录另有 **`.all-contributorsrc`** 与 **`.czrc`****（**⭐ 即**使用 all-contributors 记录贡献、并使用 commitizen 规范提交信息**）。**⑤ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **上手要求写明**（**Node 版本由 `.nvmrc` 指定，建议经版本管理器安装**）**；**② **本地开发服务器与文档站点分开**（**README 指向站点上的指南，含**「如何对 Jøkul 做改动」**）**；**③ **实测目录规模**为 **`packages/` 1,378 个文件、`portal/` 261 个、`storybook-public/` 24 个、`utils/` 22 个、`actions/` 20 个、`.storybook/` 10 个、`visual-regression/` 2 个****——**⭐ 即**多包仓库 ＋ 文档门户 ＋ Storybook ＋ 视觉回归**（**⭐ 这也解释了其 626 MB 的体量**）。**⑥ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]]、[[corredor-broker-platform]]、[[open-source-economic-model]]、[[health-denial-appeals]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⭐ **许可为 **MIT****——**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**，**README 亦含 **Lisens** 一节**；**⭐ 而**本词条**未读该文件内容**；**⚠️ 但**本词条指出：**MIT 是**该保险公司就其自己有权许可的部分**授予的**，**⚠️ 而**一个设计系统**通常打包字体、图标或第三方组件**——**⭐ 与第 343／344／345 轮多次记录的同一问题一样：**仓库的许可与其中第三方资源的权利是两件不同的事****（**⭐ 本词条**未核实**其 `packages/` 下是否另有第三方许可文件**）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未使用该设计系统的任何一步****——**未安装 Node 或 pnpm、未安装该包、未构建任何组件、未打开其文档站点或 Storybook、未运行任何测试或视觉回归**；**故**本词条**不主张**其组件可用、其发布流程可跑通、或其视觉回归确实生效**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与其**经 tree 接口实测的文件结构**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何源码、组件或配置文件的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：**两条发布通道是否确实由 CI 按所述自动同步与清理**（**⚠️ 这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**）；**其组件是否确实可访问、是否符合其自述的设计原则**；**Biome 是否确实在提交时自动运行**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其无障碍性、浏览器兼容性或版本支持范围**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读其文档站点**，**亦**未运行任何审计**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**该保险公司与该项目之间的实际关系、以及该项目是否被用于其真实产品**（**⭐ 其自述为**该公司开发的设计系统**；**⚠️ 本词条**未访问其产品、未核实任何部署**）。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**该设计系统适用于任何其他机构的产品**（**⚠️ 它带有**具体品牌的设计原则**）。**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其作者与贡献者名单的真实性**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读 `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` 或贡献者名录**）。**⑧ ⭐ **★77、fork 32**，**是本会话所收条目中关注度较高的一条****（**⭐ 且 fork 数 32 说明有相当多的人取用**）**——**⭐ 本词条**不主张**星数与质量的关系**。**⑨ ⚠️ **创建在解冻窗口之前（2019-06-14）****——**⭐ 如实记录该日期（**其创建远早于窗口**），**其入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-10）****。**⑩ ⚠️ **README 为**挪威语****——**⭐ 这是本条目在**语言维度上的一处新增覆盖**（**本站此前已收日语、意大利语、西班牙语等**）；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**已覆盖北欧语言生态**（**该条是**由机构轴检索命中的**，**而非挪威语关键词**）。**⑪ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/fremtind/jokul` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可 MIT、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间、topics 与 homepage）；README 31,193 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**本词条据其引用其首句、交付方式两段、发布流程两段与 ESLint 冲突一段**）；**其 `LICENSE` 文件的存在经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 探测确认（HTTP 200）**；**其文件树经 `https://api.github.com/repos/…/git/trees/main?recursive=1` 实测读取（返回 1,776 个文件、551 个目录，`truncated` 为 false；本词条据其核对 `packages/`、`portal/`、`utils/`、`actions/`、`.storybook/`、`visual-regression/`、`.all-contributorsrc` 与 `.czrc`）**；**未克隆、未下载 tarball（626 MB 体量）、未安装任何依赖、未构建任何东西、未打开其文档站点或线上站点、未读任何源码或配置内容、未做任何网络观察、未打开任何图**。

**fremtind-design-system**（倉庫 `fremtind/jokul`，站點名 Jøkul）**是一家挪威保險公司（Fremtind）開源的**對外**設計系統**：**其 README 首句逐字為** **「**Jøkul** er et designsystem utviklet av Fremtind.」**（「Jøkul 是由 Fremtind 開發的設計系統」）。**實測 ★77、fork 32、許可 **MIT**（**實測倉庫內含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主語言 TypeScript、體量 **626,003 KB**、**創建 2019-06-14**、最後推送 2026-09-10、topics 為 `design-system`／`designsystem`／`fremtind`／`react`／`sass`／`scss`**（**⚠️ 創建遠早於解凍窗口，推送落在窗口之內**）；**README 實測 31,193 位元組（**挪威語**）**；**倉庫實測共 **1,776 個文件、551 個目錄**（**經 GitHub API tree 接口實測，`truncated` 為 false**）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把平時不外傳的東西拿出來」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**唯一由**一家保險公司自己的工程組織**發布、且已長期維護的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與 tree 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一家保險公司把自己的設計系統開源出去，而交付方式被逐條說明**：**「Jøkul gir deg **ferdige React-komponenter** samt **CSS- og SCSS-stilark** for de grunnleggende komponentene og **designmønstrene** til Fremtind. **fremtind-design-system** (repository `fremtind/jokul`, site name Jøkul) **is the outward-facing design system that a Norwegian insurer has open-sourced**: **its first line reads verbatim that Jøkul is a design system developed by Fremtind**. **Measured ★77, 32 forks, licence **MIT** (a `LICENSE` file is measurably present), primary language TypeScript, a **626,003 KB** repository, **created 2019-06-14**, last pushed 2026-09-10, topics `design-system`, `designsystem`, `fremtind`, `react`, `sass` and `scss`** (all GitHub API measurements; ⚠️ **creation far predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **the README measures 31,193 bytes and is in **Norwegian****; **the repository measures 1,776 files and 551 directories**, read through the trees endpoint with truncation false. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **bringing out what is normally kept in-house**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the only one published by an insurer’s own engineering organisation and maintained over years**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① An insurer open-sources its design system, and the delivery form is itemised** — verbatim, Jøkul gives ready-made React components plus CSS and SCSS stylesheets for Fremtind’s basic components and design patterns, following Fremtind’s design principles; **and it states verbatim that all components and stylesheets are now delivered as one consolidated package while the CSS remains available as separate stylesheets, so that you can still use Jøkul if you do not use React** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **design system here means an outward-facing component library and pattern set rather than internal documentation, so an insurer has open-sourced the language of its customer-facing interfaces**; ⭐⭐ **the consolidated package and the separately usable stylesheets coexist with the reason written for people who do not use React, so the delivery choice carries a statement of whom it serves**; **and the components follow that company’s design principles, making this a branded artifact rather than a generic library**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ A two-channel release process is written out in ten steps, down to conflict handling and automatic cleanup** — verbatim, the main branch publishes **stable versions**; **in addition the release-next branch is automatically synced with main on every push to main**, so the prerelease branch keeps pace with what has already been merged and stably published; **and if the sync hits merge conflicts, a fixed sync branch and a single sync pull request against the release branch are reused for manual resolution, with the sync branch cleaned up automatically once it is no longer needed provided it holds no own commits missing from the release branch**; **with the changeset flow and specific release commands given** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the relationship between the two channels is spelled out, with the prerelease branch following the stable one automatically, so not falling behind is guaranteed by mechanism rather than by memory**; ⭐⭐⭐ **conflict handling reuses a fixed branch and one pull request rather than creating new ones each time, a concrete and reusable collaboration detail**; ⭐⭐ **the automatic cleanup carries a precondition, guarding against deleting unmerged commits**; **and ⭐⭐ command-level steps make the process followable by others**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It explains item by item why ESLint should be disabled** — verbatim, the project uses Biome for both formatting and linting, which happens automatically on commit, and configuring the IDE for Biome is recommended **so that it does not quarrel with our settings**; **with the exact steps given, namely clearing the enable checkbox for ESLint, turning off its formatting, and noting that the same changes should be made in the workspace settings** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"so it does not quarrel with our settings" admits that tooling conflicts are real while stating which side it chose**; ⭐⭐ **concrete switches are given rather than leaving configuration to the reader**, ⭐ **the same family as round 341’s automatic disabling of a feature together with an on-screen explanation, since both refuse a silent tooling conflict**; **and ⭐⭐ making the same changes in the workspace recognises multi-project setups**. **④ ⭐⭐ Governance and contribution surfaces are complete, and the code of conduct is in Norwegian** — verbatim, Jøkul is an open and positive community where everyone should feel welcome, and contributors should familiarise themselves with the ethical rules for contributors before taking part ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **the code of conduct is a separate file written in Norwegian**; **⭐ the README’s sections include the code of conduct, a licence section and a contributors section, so rights, behaviour and contributors each have a place**; **and ⭐ the root measurably holds an all-contributors configuration and a commitizen configuration, using one to record contributions and the other to standardise commit messages**. **⑤ ⭐ Other details**: **getting-started requirements are stated, with the Node version pinned in a file and installed via a version manager recommended**; **the local development server and the documentation site are separate, with guides on the site including how to make changes to Jøkul**; **and measured directory sizes are 1,378 files under packages, 261 under the portal, 24 public storybook files, 22 utilities, 20 actions, 10 storybook configuration files and 2 visual-regression files**, ⭐ **a multi-package repository plus a documentation portal, storybook and visual regression, which also explains its 626 MB size**. **⑥ ⭐ Readable with** [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]], [[corredor-broker-platform]], [[open-source-economic-model]] and [[health-denial-appeals]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐ Licence is MIT** — **a `LICENSE` file is measurably present and the README carries a licence section**, ⚠️ **whose contents were not read**; ⚠️ **and the entry notes that MIT is granted by the insurer over the portion it has the right to license, while a design system typically bundles fonts, icons or third-party components — the same class of question as recorded several times in rounds 343 through 345, where a repository’s licence and the rights in third-party resources inside it are two different things**, ⚠️ **and whether further third-party licence files sit under the packages directory was not verified**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No part of the design system was used** — **neither Node nor pnpm was installed, the package was not installed, no component was built, its documentation site and storybook were not opened, and no test or visual regression was run**; **so its components are not claimed to work, its release process is not claimed to run, and its visual regression is not claimed to function** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and its file structure as measured through the trees endpoint**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source, component or configuration file was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether the two release channels really sync and clean up automatically as described, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry; whether its components are really accessible and follow the stated design principles; and whether Biome really runs automatically on commit**. **④ ⚠️ Its accessibility, browser compatibility and version support were not verified**. **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ The actual relationship between the insurer and this project, and whether it is used in its real products, were not verified**. **⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that the design system applies to any other organisation’s product**, **since it carries specific brand design principles**. **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The authenticity of its authors and contributors was not verified**. **⑧ ⭐ At ★77 with 32 forks**, **this is among the more noticed entries this session has collected**, ⭐ **the forks indicating substantial uptake**, ⭐ **without claiming any relation between stars and quality**. **⑨ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2019-06-14** — **selection resting on the push falling inside the window (2026-09-10)**. **⑩ ⚠️ The README is in Norwegian** — ⭐ **a new language for the site’s coverage**, ⚠️ **though Nordic coverage is not claimed, since this entry was found through an organisation search rather than a Norwegian keyword**. **⑪ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/fremtind/jokul` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence MIT, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates, topics and homepage); the 31,193-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, the entry quoting its first line, its two delivery paragraphs, its two release-process passages and its ESLint-conflict passage; **the existence of its `LICENSE` file was confirmed by a raw probe returning 200**; **its file tree was read through the recursive trees endpoint, returning 1,776 files and 551 directories with truncation false**; **nothing was cloned, no tarball was downloaded given its 626 MB size, no dependency was installed, nothing was built, its documentation and live sites were not opened, no source or configuration contents were read, no network observation was made, and no image was opened**.
